learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to manage stress effectively, set SMART goals, build self-motivation, and manage your time to achieve personal and academic excellence!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: लचीलापन / संकट से उबरने की क्षमता

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Stress is our emotional and physical reaction to challenges. Effective coping strategies include physical exercise, yoga/meditation, proper sleep, time management, and positive self-talk.
Intrinsic motivation comes from within (doing something because you love it or want to grow), while extrinsic motivation comes from external rewards (money, grades, praise).
Goals should be SMART: Specific (clear target), Measurable (trackable progress), Achievable (realistic), Relevant (aligned with your values), and Time-bound (has a deadline).

main_concepts.concept_title: ⏰ Four Steps of Effective Time Management
main_concepts.simple_explanation: 1) Organize (keep a clean workspace and schedule), 2) Prioritize (do important tasks first), 3) Control (avoid procrastination and distractions), 4) Track (monitor how you spend your day).

fun_activity.title: 🎯 Make One SMART Goal
fun_activity.instructions: Convert a vague goal like 'I will study more' into a SMART goal! Example: 'I will solve 10 IT multiple-choice questions every evening at 6 PM for the next 5 days.' Notice how much easier it is to act on!

exam_tips: 📌 You must know the full form of SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound) by heart.
📌 Give practical examples of 'Eustress' (positive, motivating stress before a game or test) vs. 'Distress' (negative, debilitating stress).
📌 Explain how self-awareness (knowing your strengths and weaknesses) is the foundation of self-management.
quick_recap: ⭐ Independent working requires self-discipline, self-monitoring, and taking responsibility for your own actions.
⭐ The Pomodoro technique (working for 25 minutes, then taking a 5-minute break) is a powerful time-management tool.
⭐ Positive thinking transforms obstacles into learning opportunities.
